items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Well, him and I, him and Chris stayed right close to each other. I know that.

ctx.x: The man thing right now you try to do is see if you can hook up and get that picture of Wooden Joe with Chris Kelly on. I'mma see for it. I'mma see for it. That's what we want. I'mma get it for you. That's what we want. That's the man thing right now. So if we can get a picture of Chris Kelly, that'd be something, you know? Chris Kelly and Buddy Petit? I guess I done asked every old musician. I'mma see for it.
What I know. You know how to have Chris Kelly's picture? He would got Ike. What I say? Big Ike would got his legs off. Big Ike?
